interface.title: Penumbra — Exoplanet Analytics
interface.stage_of_work: exploratory analysis and reporting of results already computed (descriptive statistics, hypothesis tests and the evaluation of a trained model)
interface.what_it_is_for: Filter the NASA Exoplanet Archive confirmed-planet catalog by discovery year and method, and see how the observed population and a Random Forest mass model differ by discovery method.

data.note: The app comes with the cleaned catalog (6,336 planets, 4,749 host stars, 11 discovery methods, 1992–2026) and fixed model outputs. Nothing was uploaded. The sidebar filters change only Discovery Explorer, Planet Relationships and the Planet Lookup list. Overview, Statistical Findings and Mass Model stay fixed (screens/045.webp, screens/047.webp, screens/024.webp).

tree.general: Find out how the way items were detected shapes the observed population, and how well a predictive model recovers a key property
tree.specific: Characterize how Transit, Radial Velocity and Microlensing exoplanets differ, and evaluate the Random Forest planet-mass model
